answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its relic recurs, its tundra survives audit, and a walnut from an unlinked peer confirms it.
